tools.name: get_meta
tools.description: Dataset version, public tileset URLs, sources and licences. Works without a key within a daily free quota.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: All countries and dependencies with their profile. Works without a key within a daily free quota.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: One country: names, calling codes, currencies, languages, timezones, levels with coverage. Works without a key within a daily free quota.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Children of a place (`parent`) or a name prefix search (`q`); exactly one of the two. Works without a key within a daily free quota.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: One place with its path (ancestors, country first). Works without a key within a daily free quota.

tools.name: get_place_boundary
tools.description: The boundary as one GeoJSON Feature (application/geo+json, not wrapped in `data`), ready for MapLibre. properties: id, name, detail, dataset_version, attribution. Sent gzip-compressed when the client accepts gzip. A reply over 200 KB, or detail=full, is not inlined: the result is its REST URL and si

tools.name: find_places_at_point
tools.description: Every unit whose land contains the point (country, region, county; in Turkey also mahalle), most general first; match is none at sea or outside the loaded countries. Needs an API key: the MCP client sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

tools.name: get_timezone
tools.description: IANA timezone of a point (timezone-boundary-builder polygons: land and territorial waters) with the current UTC offset, DST flag and local time; match is none on the open sea. `dst` is true when the zone's clocks are advanced at that instant: its offset is the larger of the two it shows in that year

tools.name: find_nearby_places
tools.description: The nearest populated places (GeoNames cities500: 500 inhabitants or more, or a seat of government) with distance in km, population and path, nearest first. 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature. Needs an API key: the MCP client sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

tools.name: lookup_postal_code
tools.description: The places of a postal code (GeoNames); case, spaces and hyphens in the code are ignored. `partial` is true for the countries GeoNames gives only in part (CA, NL, GB: first part; CL, CN, AR: first digits; IE, MT: first letters; BR: major codes). 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature. N

tools.name: find_nearby_postal_codes
tools.description: The postal codes nearest to a point (GeoNames), nearest first, with distance in km. 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature. Needs an API key: the MCP client sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

tools.name: validate_phone_number
tools.description: Validate and format a phone number. Works without a key within a daily free quota.

tools.name: get_caller_location
tools.description: The caller's own location, from Cloudflare's IP geolocation (edge only: the Worker at api.forlab.io/geo answers it, the Python service does not). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_meta, get_place_boundary · Private data: get_place_boundary, find_places_at_point, get_timezone, find_nearby_places, lookup_postal_code, find_nearby_postal_codes, get_caller_location · Public sink: get_timezone, get_caller_location · Destructive: validate_phone_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_meta, get_place_boundary · Private data: get_place_boundary, find_places_at_point, get_timezone, find_nearby_places, lookup_postal_code, find_nearby_postal_codes, get_caller_location · Public sink: get_timezone, get_caller_location · Destructive: validate_phone_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
